title: Microsoft Windows win32full Improper Release Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the win32kfull driver. The issue results from improper management of a reference count. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
